Weekend run (4 Oct): retraining on 16 000 real normal windows, 36 LLM-confirmed fire windows, 16 LLM-rejected
and 1 600 augmented nuisance windows reproduced the deployed model (real-normal 0.997 vs 0.998, fire detection
0.917 vs 0.917, ONNX parity 1.000), so the deployed model was kept.
